title: S4 project directives: duplicate propulsion, disable craft at a distance

tellings.quote: directive was duplicate the propulsion system at any cost is directive one and directive two was be able to disable the system at a distance at any cost.

plain: In 1988 and 1989, the work at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert, had two standing orders: first, copy the craft's propulsion system "at any cost", and second, find a way to disable that system from a distance, also at any cost. That is how Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked at S4, describes it to Jesse Michels from his own time there. If true, it would mean the goal was both to copy the technology and to be able to defend against it.
